Reply to Media Query on CPL(NS) Toh Wei Song, Owen

23 September 2026

The Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) holds its service personnel to high standards of discipline and integrity. Service personnel who commit offences will be dealt with in accordance with the law.

CPL(NS) Toh Wei Song, Owen was suspended from all duties following his arrest in 2024, and was subsequently released from regular service. He is no longer with the SAF.
